senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; גּוּד)thread, chord, sinew, artery, tendon.—ג׳ הַנָּשֶׁה (b. h.) nervus ischiadicus.
units: Ḥull. VII, 1 גיד הנ׳ נוהג וכ׳ the law concerning the nervus ischiadicus (Gen. XXXII, 33) applies &c. Ib. 89ᵇ, a. fr. איסור ג׳ (sub. הנשה) the prohibitory law concerning &c.—Euphem. membrum virile.
<cite ref="Chullin 100b:3">Ib. 100ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין בג׳ בנ״ט</he> the rule for mixtures of forbidden and permitted things to be decided by taste-giving quantities applies not to tendons.

<cite ref="Chullin 90b:18">Ib. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ צואר</he> the blood vessels of the throat, contrad. to <he>ג׳ בשר</he> soft tendons.—Y. Meg. I, 17ᵈ top <he>תופרין בג׳</he> the T’fillin are sewed with threads of dried tendons.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:5">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>ג׳ של אדמה</he> fibres of dried roots in the ground.
Maasr. I, 2 [אדומים] משיטילו ג׳ (v. comment.) when they (the peaches) get [red] veins; Y. ib. I, 48ᵈ bot.—Denom. גִּיֵּיד q. v. [גִּיד, pl. גִּידִּין worm-wood, v. גִּידָּא II.]
